subject: Request: Weekend P1 response exception for FinEdge (urgent)
messages:
From: Claudia Moore <claudia@finedge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: support@finedge.com, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: weekend P1 response time exception for planned migration

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

We're doing a planned data migration to our new payments service over the weekend (Fri 08/07 22:00 PDT -> Sun 08/09 04:00 PDT). Given the business impact if something goes wrong, FinEdge is asking for a temporary SLA exception for P1 response during that maintenance window: a guaranteed live human response within 15 minutes and an elevated on-call roster for 24/7 coverage across the migration window.

Summary of ask:
- Temporary SLA: P1 live-response within 15 minutes (instead of standard 60) for 2026-08-07 22:00 -> 2026-08-09 04:00 PDT
- Primary contact: Claudia Moore (claudia@finedge.com)
- Escalation matrix: see attached CSV (weekend-escalation-matrix.csv)
- SOC2 evidence required for procurement (attached)

We understand this is outside standard terms; please let us know required approvals, potential cost, and on-call ops plan. Procurement also requested a one-page addendum for the temporary change.

Thanks,
Claudia
Claudia Moore
IT Operations Lead, FinEdge Inc.
Attachment: weekend-escalation-matrix.csv (csv)
Attachment: SOC2-Attestation.pdf (pdf)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Moore <claudia@finedge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend P1 response time exception for planned migration

Claudia — thanks for the heads up. We can support a temporary tightening of P1 live-response to 15 minutes for that window, but I need to confirm two things with the team before I confirm to procurement:

1) On-call coverage: what you want is a dedicated escalation pair (1 primary, 1 backup) staffed across the window with rotation so response is guaranteed within 15 minutes. That will require assigning engineers and paying an overtime/temporary on-call premium.
2) Scope of incidents: is this limited to Redwood platform outages impacting FinEdge or does it include application-level issues tied to FinEdge config? We prefer to limit the very strict SLA to Redwood platform-impacting P1s.

Marissa / Grace / Sean — can you confirm availability and estimated cost (hourly premium) to staff an elevated rota for the dates Claudia listed, and whether legal needs a one-off addendum?

I will hold off replying to procurement until we have numbers.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Support & Reliability, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>
Cc: Claudia Moore <claudia@finedge.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Aug 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend P1 response time exception for planned migration

Vivek — quick notes after sync with ops and finance: 

- We can staff two dedicated on-call rotations (US switchover shifts) for the entire window. Estimated incremental cost: $6,400 for the 30-hour window (overtime + temporary bump).
- We recommend narrowing "P1" coverage to Redwood platform-severity P1s (service down, model-serving unavailable, regional network errors). Application/config issues owned by FinEdge devs would be triaged at standard response.
- Legal: a one-paragraph addendum phrasing the temporary SLA exception (dates + scope limitation) should be sufficient — legal can turn it in 24 business hours.

Claudia — if FinEdge accepts the scope limitation and cost, we'll prepare the addendum and the on-call roster.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cost-breakdown.xlsx (note: attachment not included in thread export)

From: Claudia Moore <claudia@finedge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finedge.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend P1 response time exception for planned migration

Thanks — that's reasonable. Procurement has confirmed budget approval for the $6.4k incremental cost. FinEdge accepts the scope limitation (platform-impacting P1s only). Please proceed with the addendum and on-call roster. Can you also confirm the primary on-call contact and an emergency phone number?

Claudia
Claudia Moore
IT Operations Lead, FinEdge Inc.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: weekend P1 response time exception for planned migration

Claudia — good to hear. Final operational plan below and I've looped legal to draft the addendum.

Operational plan (summary):
- Temporary SLA: P1 live human response within 15 minutes for platform-impacting P1 incidents only. Window: 2026-08-07 22:00 PDT -> 2026-08-09 04:00 PDT.
- On-call roster: Primary: Sean Gallagher (sean@redwood.com, +1-415-555-0123); Backup: Grace Oconnor (grace@redwood.com, +1-415-555-0178). Both have confirmed availability and will be paid the temporary premium.
- Escalation path: Primary -> Backup (10 min) -> Vivek (20 min) -> Senior Engineering on-call (30 min) -> Exec escalation. Detailed matrix attached (weekend-escalation-matrix.csv).
- Addendum: Legal will produce a one-paragraph temporary SLA addendum and send via DocuSign by EOD tomorrow.

Link to support ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4512
